Renders real-time telemetry across middle-brain holons, intent stream hydrators,
and river convergence pipelines, evaluating alignment scores and system vitality.

Usage:
  zqk system holon status [flags]

Aliases:
  status, stat

Flags:
      --engine[=true|false]   Output ambient engine runtime telemetry report
  -f, --format string         Output format (table, json) (default "table")
      --json[=true|false]     Output telemetry snapshot as JSON

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded[=true|false]   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
